reason: The README clearly describes a DSH skill that sends email alerts when an agent completes, blocks, needs a decision, or reaches a milestone, using configured SMTP credentials and recipients.

summaries.zh: 这是一个为 DSH 智能体提供邮件提醒的插件，可在任务完成、阻塞、需要决策或达到里程碑时通过 SMTP 发送通知。
summaries.en: A DSH skill that sends SMTP email notifications when an agent completes a task, becomes blocked, needs a decision, or reaches a milestone.

capabilities: Sends one-way email notifications through configured SMTP servers
Reads SMTP configuration including an authorization code and recipient address
Makes outbound network connections to SMTP services
Provides an SMTP configuration and authentication self-test without sending email
